_note: Store defaults. Per-company overrides live in the store_setting table (/store/settings/). No secrets in this file. Entitlement gates are off unless enforce is true. seller_domain is the brand that sells add-ons (your platform domain).

entitlements._note: Price and free_count for a gate belong here, not hard-coded. Watermarks: first free_count owner-watermarked public files are free, then price/month.
